# lean-pkg new

scaffold a new Lean package (Challenge/Solution, comparator.json, claims, coverage, verify.sh) in a new directory and git init it; no registry, no network.

## Usage

```text
lean-pkg new [--dir DIR] [--module MOD] [--no-mathlib] [--author TEXT]
             [--license {Apache-2.0,MIT}] [common flags] NAME
```

`[common flags]`: `--json`, `--commit`, `--push`, `--no-commit`, also accepted before the command name; see the [CLI overview](../cli.md).

Write a minimal Lean 4 package that comparator-receipt, `receipt systemd`, gate and page accept unchanged, then `git init` it. Nothing is committed, fetched or built; no registry is read or written. Next steps: docs/quickstart.md.

## Arguments and flags

| Argument or flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `NAME` | the package name: lower-case letters, digits, single hyphens (e.g. my-proof) |
| `--dir DIR` | where to write it (default ./NAME); refused when it exists and is not empty |
| `--module MOD` | the library and namespace (default: NAME in CamelCase, my-proof -&gt; MyProof) |
| `--no-mathlib` | core Lean only: no Mathlib dependency (fast to build; comparator-receipt then needs COMPARATOR_RECEIPT_NO_MATHLIB=1) |
| `--author TEXT` | the CITATION.cff author (default: git config user.name) |
| `--license {Apache-2.0,MIT}` | the LICENSE written (default Apache-2.0); pass the same id to `update NAME --license-spdx`. Choices: `Apache-2.0`, `MIT`. |

## Details

| `new NAME` | scaffold a minimal Lean package in a new directory (or `--dir DIR`) and initialize Git; nothing is committed, fetched or built, and no registry is read or written. Includes a Mathlib-backed project by default, or core Lean with `--no-mathlib`, plus a verification script and the files needed for a package page. See the [quickstart](../quickstart.md). | `[--dir DIR] [--module MOD] [--no-mathlib] [--author TEXT] [--license Apache-2.0\|MIT] [--json]` |

## Exit codes

0 success (dry runs and no-ops included), 1 refused or failed, 2 usage error; see [Exit codes](../cli.md#exit-codes).

## Examples

Scaffold a minimal Lean package without Mathlib; the command initializes Git but does not build, commit, or access the registry.

```bash
lean-pkg new my-proof --no-mathlib
```
